title: Why Your SSD Slows Down Over Time

scenes.text: A single SSD cell can hold three bits of data
scenes.query: TLC NAND three bits per cell
scenes.query2: Triple level cell SSD data per cell

scenes.text: TLC stores 3 bits per cell, while SLC stores only 1 bit
scenes.query: TLC vs SLC bits per cell

scenes.text: Writing a TLC cell requires up to 3 program‑and‑erase cycles per write
Those extra cycles cause faster wear, so TLC SSDs lose speed sooner than SLC drives
